dedupe_keys.name: modified roofpedia four class rooftop mapping of existing and potential green roofs from open swiss data bern

description: Modified-Roofpedia extends the Roofpedia deep learning pipeline of the National University of Singapore's Urban Analytics Lab so that it maps both existing green roofs and roofs with potential for greening. A U-Net segmentation model with four classes labels each building as an existing green roof, a flat roof suitable for greening, a roof with solar panels or a flat roof unsuitable for greening, using roof slopes from swissSURFACE3D to drop steep roofs. Htet Yamin Ko Ko released the code and a preprint on 24 July 2026, relying only on open swisstopo data: SWISSIMAGE orthophotos, swissSURFACE3D and swissTLM3D footprints. Coverage is the city of Bern, and the method is transferable to other Swiss cities. Validation mIoU was 0.78, and building-level accuracy across the four classes was 51 percent. Format and access: Python code on GitHub. Licence: MIT; free. Caveats: the four-class accuracy is modest, and suitability ignores structural load limits. It gives a resource potential layer for green roof planning and urban heat adaptation. Related catalogue records are Roofpedia and the STDL PROJ-VEGROOFS green roof detection.
